recreation_brief: 1. Set light gray background (#E8E8E8). 2. Add title 'Vector Notation for Linear Regression and Classification (One Sample)' at top, bold, dark red for main part, dark blue for '(One Sample)'. 3. Add yellow circle with '15' at top-right. 4. Left column: three pale yellow boxes (#FFFFCC) with thin borders. 5. First box: 'Model' in red italic, then 'I/P: ( x1 x2 x3 ..... xn )   O/P: ( y )'. 6. Second box: 'Model' in red italic, then 'y = w1x1 + w2x2 + w2x2 + ... + wdxd + b' with w's in blue, x's in red, b in green. 7. Below: 'y = W^T X + b' with W^T in blue, X in red, b in green. 8. Third box: 'y = ( w1 w2 .... wd ) · ( x1 x2 ... xd )^T + b' with w's in blue, x's in red, b in green. 9. Right side: pale yellow box with 'Input:' in red, 'X =' then column vector (x1 x2 x3 ... xd) in red; 'W =' then column vector (W1 W2 W3 ... Wd) in blue; 'Output: ( y )' with y in red. 10. Use thin dark borders around boxes.
